name: kling-ai
description: Generate and edit images, create videos from text and reference media, and check your Kling AI credits and generation progress.

interface.longDescription: Generate images and videos from text prompts or reference media with Kling AI (可灵AI). Create product photos, posters, portraits, social media content, and videos with one or more shots. Use start and end frames, motion control, and reusable subjects (Elements) with models that support them. Upload reference images, videos, and audio, manage Elements, browse the motion library, check your credit balance, and track generation progress. A connected Kling AI account is required. Generation uses Kling AI credits. Model availability and supported settings vary by account.
defaultPrompt: Draw a red panda in a vintage spacesuit floating by a space station window, lit by Earth’s blue glow, cinematic and detailed
Use Kling 4.0 to create a 5-second cinematic video: a mecha crashes down, blasting rubble as the camera rushes in.
Use Kling 4.0 to create a 15-second sneaker ad: street action, product close-ups, and a detailed final hero shot.
